source: Original English paraphrases of the Zhou Yi (classical Chinese text, public domain), written for Vajra.Stream in 2026 and released under the project's MIT licence. Hexagram names follow common English renderings.

hexagrams.name: Qian
hexagrams.judgment: Origin, flourishing, benefit, constancy. The creative force moves from its source and carries everything through to completion when it stays true.
hexagrams.image: Heaven above heaven: its course turns without pause. The wise person makes themselves strong and never lets their effort lapse.
hexagrams.meaning: Pure active energy, leadership, persistent action
hexagrams.images: Heaven above heaven: its course turns without pause. The wise person makes themselves strong and never lets their effort lapse.
lines: The dragon lies submerged in the deep. The moment has not come; do not act yet.
The dragon shows itself in the open field. It is favourable to meet a person of great worth.
The noble-minded work tirelessly all day and stay watchful into the night. There is danger, but no fault.
Something leaps, or stays in the depths of the pool. Either choice is free of fault.
The dragon soars through the sky. It is favourable to meet a person of great worth.
The dragon has climbed too high. There will be cause for regret.

hexagrams.name: Kun
hexagrams.judgment: Origin and flourishing; benefit comes from the steadiness of the mare. Going ahead first leads astray, while following finds a guide. Friends are gained in the southwest and parted from in the northeast; calm constancy brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Earth upon earth, broad and yielding. The wise person, with generous character, bears and supports all things.
hexagrams.meaning: Pure yielding energy, nurturing, dedication, patience
hexagrams.images: Earth upon earth, broad and yielding. The wise person, with generous character, bears and supports all things.
lines: Frost crunches underfoot; hard ice will follow. Small signs announce what is coming.
Straight, square and great. Without rehearsing, nothing goes amiss.
Keep your gifts hidden and remain steady. If you serve a ruler, claim no achievement, and the work will still reach its end.
A sack tied shut at the mouth. No fault, and no praise.
A robe of yellow below, the colour of the centre. Great good fortune.
Dragons battle in the open country; their blood runs dark and yellow.

hexagrams.name: Zhun
hexagrams.judgment: Great flourishing comes through steadiness at the very beginning. Do not set out to go anywhere; it is favourable to appoint helpers and establish order.
hexagrams.image: Clouds and thunder fill the air: the tangle of first growth. The wise person sorts the threads and weaves them into order.
hexagrams.meaning: Sprouting seed, dynamic growth against initial obstacles
hexagrams.images: Clouds and thunder fill the air: the tangle of first growth. The wise person sorts the threads and weaves them into order.
lines: Hesitating, circling a boulder. It is favourable to stay steady and to appoint helpers.
Stuck and turning back, the horses pull apart. These are not raiders but suitors. The maiden waits ten years before she gives her promise.
Chasing deer without a forester, one only wanders deeper into the woods. The wise person sees this and stops; to press on brings humiliation.
The horses pull apart, yet one seeks a union. Going forward brings good fortune; everything turns out well.
The rich provisions are held back. Steadiness in small matters brings good fortune; in great matters, misfortune.
The horses pull apart and tears of blood flow without end.

hexagrams.name: Meng
hexagrams.judgment: Flourishing. I do not go looking for the young and untaught; they come looking for me. The first consultation is answered, but asking again and again is disrespect, and disrespect gets no answer. Steadiness is favourable.
hexagrams.image: Below the mountain a spring emerges. The wise person acts decisively and nourishes their inner worth.
hexagrams.meaning: Inexperience, requirement of a teacher, open-minded study
hexagrams.images: Below the mountain a spring emerges. The wise person acts decisively and nourishes their inner worth.
lines: To open the eyes of the untaught, some discipline helps, and then the shackles can be removed. Going on in fetters brings humiliation.
Bearing patiently with the untaught brings good fortune. Taking a wife is fortunate; the child is able to run the household.
Do not take a bride who loses herself at the sight of a wealthy man. Nothing good comes of it.
Ignorance hemmed in on every side. Humiliation.
Childlike openness to learning. Good fortune.
Striking at ignorance. Do not act like a raider; it is favourable to guard against raiders.

hexagrams.name: Xu
hexagrams.judgment: With sincerity, there is bright flourishing; steadiness brings good fortune. It is favourable to cross the great river.
hexagrams.image: Clouds have risen into the sky, and the rain must be waited for. The wise person eats, drinks and is at ease in the meantime.
hexagrams.meaning: Patience, collecting strength, letting things mature naturally
hexagrams.images: Clouds have risen into the sky, and the rain must be waited for. The wise person eats, drinks and is at ease in the meantime.
lines: Waiting out in the open meadow. It is favourable to keep a steady routine; no fault.
Waiting out on the sandbank. A few words of complaint are heard; at the last, good fortune.
Waiting in the mud draws raiders near.
Waiting in blood. Climb out of the pit.
Waiting with food and wine. Steadiness brings good fortune.
Sinking into the pit. Three guests turn up unbidden; receive them with courtesy and all ends well.

hexagrams.name: Song
hexagrams.judgment: You are sincere but obstructed; stay cautious. Stopping halfway brings good fortune; pushing to the end brings misfortune. It is favourable to meet a person of great worth, but not to cross the great river.
hexagrams.image: Heaven and water move in opposite directions. The wise person plans carefully at the very start of any undertaking.
hexagrams.meaning: Disputes, need to seek arbitration, stop half-way
hexagrams.images: Heaven and water move in opposite directions. The wise person plans carefully at the very start of any undertaking.
lines: Do not drag the matter out. There is a little talk, but in the end good fortune.
Unable to win the dispute, one withdraws and returns home. The three hundred households of the town suffer no harm.
Living on the virtue of the past. Steadiness amid danger ends in good fortune. If serving a ruler, seek no credit.
Unable to win, one turns back and accepts what is fitting. A change of heart and calm constancy bring good fortune.
Bringing the dispute to judgment. Great good fortune.
Someone may be granted a ceremonial belt, only to have it taken away three times before the morning is over.

hexagrams.name: Shi
hexagrams.judgment: Steadiness under an experienced, mature leader brings good fortune and no fault.
hexagrams.image: Water held within the earth. The wise person is generous toward the people and gathers and sustains the multitude.
hexagrams.meaning: Leadership, collective discipline, alignment towards a goal
hexagrams.images: Water held within the earth. The wise person is generous toward the people and gathers and sustains the multitude.
lines: The troops march out in good order. Without discipline, whatever happens leads to misfortune.
In the midst of the troops. Good fortune and no fault; the king honours them three times.
The troops may come back carrying corpses in the wagons. Misfortune.
The troops fall back and make camp. No fault.
Birds in the field: it is favourable to capture them, and no fault. The elder brother should command; if the younger one does, carts bring back the dead, and stubbornness ends badly.
The ruler issues commands, founding states and granting houses. Do not employ petty people.

hexagrams.name: Bi
hexagrams.judgment: Holding together brings good fortune. Consult the oracle again: if there is lasting, deep steadiness, there is no fault. The uneasy come gathering; whoever arrives late meets misfortune.
hexagrams.image: Water lies upon the earth. The ancient kings founded the many states and kept close bonds with their lords.
hexagrams.meaning: Union, alliance, mutual support and community strength
hexagrams.images: Water lies upon the earth. The ancient kings founded the many states and kept close bonds with their lords.
lines: Join with them in sincerity; no fault. Sincerity filling an earthen jar brings good fortune from an unexpected quarter.
Holding together from within. Steadiness brings good fortune.
Holding together with the wrong people.
Holding together with those outside. Steadiness brings good fortune.
Open and visible union. The king hunts on three sides only, letting the game ahead escape; the townspeople need no warning. Good fortune.
Holding together without a head. Misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Xiao Chu
hexagrams.english: The Taming Power of the Small
hexagrams.judgment: Flourishing. Thick clouds gather over the western outskirts, but the rain has not yet come.
hexagrams.image: Wind moves across the heavens. The wise person refines the grace of their character and conduct.
hexagrams.name_english: The Taming Power of the Small
hexagrams.meaning: Gentle restraint, small progress, accumulating wind
hexagrams.images: Wind moves across the heavens. The wise person refines the grace of their character and conduct.
lines: Returning by one's own path; how could there be any fault? Good fortune.
Being drawn back to the path along with others. Good fortune.
The cart comes loose from its axle. Husband and wife turn their eyes away from each other.
With sincerity, bloodshed is avoided and fear departs. No fault.
Sincere and bound closely together, one shares one's wealth with one's neighbours.
The rain has come and rest has followed; virtue has carried its load. For the wife, persisting is dangerous. The moon is almost full; if the noble-minded set out now, misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Lu
hexagrams.judgment: Stepping on the tiger's tail, yet the tiger does not bite. Flourishing.
hexagrams.image: Sky overhead, marsh beneath. The wise person tells the lofty from the lowly and steadies what the people set their hearts on.
hexagrams.meaning: Conduct, cautious stepping, moving gracefully amidst danger
hexagrams.images: Sky overhead, marsh beneath. The wise person tells the lofty from the lowly and steadies what the people set their hearts on.
lines: Walking forward in plain simplicity. No fault.
Walking a smooth and level road. For one who lives quietly apart, steadiness brings good fortune.
The one-eyed thinks they can see; the lame thinks they can walk. Treading on the tiger's tail, they are bitten. Misfortune; a warrior acting as if they were the ruler.
Treading on the tiger's tail with great caution and alarm. In the end, good fortune.
Treading with firm resolve. Steadiness, yet with danger.
Review the road behind you and read the omens in it. If it has come full circle, great good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Tai
hexagrams.judgment: The small departs and the great arrives. Good fortune and flourishing.
hexagrams.image: Heaven and earth meet and mingle. The ruler shapes and completes the way of heaven and earth, and helps the people by what suits them.
hexagrams.meaning: Harmonious flow, heaven and earth meeting, alignment
hexagrams.images: Heaven and earth meet and mingle. The ruler shapes and completes the way of heaven and earth, and helps the people by what suits them.
lines: Pull up a reed and its roots come with it, together with its kind. Setting out brings good fortune.
Embracing even the untamed, ready to ford a river on foot, not neglecting the distant, without forming cliques: thus one walks the middle way.
No plain without a slope, no going without a return. Steadiness amid hardship brings no fault. Do not fret over your sincerity; in what you eat there is blessing.
Fluttering down, not boasting of wealth, they join their neighbours, sincere and unguarded.
Di Yi sends his younger sister away as a bride. From this come blessings and great good fortune.
The city wall tumbles back into the moat. Do not send out troops; give orders only within your own town. Persisting brings humiliation.

hexagrams.name: Pi
hexagrams.judgment: Blocked by those who are not the right people. Steadiness is not favourable for the noble-minded now. The great departs and the small arrives.
hexagrams.image: Heaven and earth do not meet. The wise person keeps their virtue modest to avoid trouble and does not seek honour through salary or rank.
hexagrams.meaning: Stagnation, retreat of noble influences, blockages
hexagrams.images: Heaven and earth do not meet. The wise person keeps their virtue modest to avoid trouble and does not seek honour through salary or rank.
lines: Pull up a reed and its roots come with it, together with its kind. Steadiness brings good fortune and flourishing.
Patient endurance and compliance. For petty people, good fortune; for the noble-minded, the stoppage itself leads to success.
They carry their shame wrapped up inside.
Acting on the mandate brings no fault. Companions share in the blessing.
The stagnation comes to rest; good fortune for a person of great worth. "It may fail, it may fail!" Bind it to the mulberry's deep roots.
The blockage is overturned. First standstill, then rejoicing.

hexagrams.name: Tong Ren
hexagrams.judgment: Fellowship in the open country brings flourishing. It is favourable to cross the great river; steadiness is favourable for the noble-minded.
hexagrams.image: Heaven together with fire. The wise person groups kindred things and tells apart the many kinds of beings.
hexagrams.meaning: Union with others in the open, shared vision
hexagrams.images: Heaven together with fire. The wise person groups kindred things and tells apart the many kinds of beings.
lines: Fellowship at the gate. No fault.
Fellowship only within the clan. Humiliation.
Troops lie concealed in the undergrowth while lookouts hold the high ground. For three years no move is made.
One climbs the wall but cannot attack. Good fortune.
In fellowship, first weeping and wailing, then laughter. After great struggle, the companions meet at last.
Fellowship in the meadow beyond the town. No regret.

hexagrams.name: Da You
hexagrams.judgment: Great abundance. Great flourishing from the source.
hexagrams.image: Fire shines high in the heavens. The wise person checks wrongdoing, raises up the good, and follows heaven's kindly will.
hexagrams.meaning: Abundant light, wealth, supreme clarity and rule of virtue
hexagrams.images: Fire shines high in the heavens. The wise person checks wrongdoing, raises up the good, and follows heaven's kindly will.
lines: No contact with what is harmful; this is not a fault. Remember hardship and there will be no fault.
A large wagon for carrying the load. There is somewhere to go; no fault.
A lord brings his wealth as tribute before the Son of Heaven; a small-minded person could never manage it.
Not flaunting one's plenty. No fault.
Sincerity shared freely, yet with dignity. Good fortune.
Blessed by heaven itself. Good fortune; everything is favourable.

hexagrams.name: Qian
hexagrams.judgment: Flourishing. The noble-minded carry things through to the end.
hexagrams.image: A mountain hidden within the earth. The wise person takes from what is too much and adds to what is too little, weighing things and giving out evenly.
hexagrams.meaning: Self-deprecation, keeping low, high values without pride
hexagrams.images: A mountain hidden within the earth. The wise person takes from what is too much and adds to what is too little, weighing things and giving out evenly.
lines: Modest about one's modesty, the noble-minded can cross the great river. Good fortune.
Modesty that makes itself heard. Steadiness brings good fortune.
Modest in the midst of hard work, the noble-minded see things through. Good fortune.
Nothing is unfavourable when modesty is put into action.
Not boasting of wealth before one's neighbours. It is favourable to take firm action; everything is favourable.
Modesty that makes itself heard. It is favourable to set the troops in motion to bring one's own town and land to order.

hexagrams.name: Yu
hexagrams.judgment: Enthusiasm. It is favourable to appoint helpers and to set the troops in motion.
hexagrams.image: Thunder breaks out of the ground and the land trembles awake. The kings of old composed music to celebrate virtue, offering it in abundance to the Highest and to the ancestors.
hexagrams.meaning: Vibrant motivation, movement follows music, readiness
hexagrams.images: Thunder breaks out of the ground and the land trembles awake. The kings of old composed music to celebrate virtue, offering it in abundance to the Highest and to the ancestors.
lines: Enthusiasm that announces itself loudly. Misfortune.
Firm as a rock, not waiting until the day is over. Steadiness brings good fortune.
Gazing upward in eager delight brings regret; hesitating also brings regret.
The source of enthusiasm: great things are gained. Do not doubt; friends gather like hair held by a clasp.
Persistently ill, yet not dying.
Enthusiasm in the dark. Even when it is complete, a change of course brings no fault.

hexagrams.name: Sui
hexagrams.judgment: Following: great success from the source, and it is favourable to be steadfast. Followed rightly, this brings no fault.
hexagrams.image: Thunder rests within the lake. So the wise person goes indoors when evening darkens and takes their rest.
hexagrams.meaning: Adapting, yielding leadership to flow of time
hexagrams.images: Thunder rests within the lake. So the wise person goes indoors when evening darkens and takes their rest.
lines: The standard one holds is changing; steadfastness brings good fortune. Going out through the gate to meet others brings achievement.
Holding on to the small boy, one loses the grown man.
Holding on to the grown man, one lets the small boy go. Following brings what one seeks; it is favourable to stay steadfast.
Following brings gains, but persisting in it brings misfortune. With sincerity on the path and a clear mind, where is the fault?
Sincere trust placed in what is good: good fortune.
Bound fast and tied in loyalty. The king makes an offering on the western mountain.

hexagrams.name: Gu
hexagrams.english: Work on what has been Spoiled [Decay]
hexagrams.judgment: Repairing what was spoiled: great success. It is favourable to cross the great river. Reflect for three days before the starting point and three days after it.
hexagrams.image: Wind blows below the mountain. So the wise person stirs the people and nourishes virtue.
hexagrams.name_english: Work on what has been Spoiled [Decay]
hexagrams.meaning: Renovating what was broken, fixing parental errors
hexagrams.images: Wind blows below the mountain. So the wise person stirs the people and nourishes virtue.
lines: Setting right what the father let decay. With such a child the late father bears no fault. There is danger, but in the end good fortune.
Setting right what the mother let decay. One should not be too rigid about it.
Setting right what the father let decay. There is a little regret, but no great fault.
Tolerating what the father let decay. Going on this way brings humiliation.
Setting right what the father let decay, and earning praise for it.
Not serving kings or lords, one sets one's own aims higher still.

hexagrams.name: Lin
hexagrams.judgment: Approach: great success, and it is favourable to be steadfast. When the eighth month comes, there will be misfortune.
hexagrams.image: Earth lies above the lake. So the wise person teaches and cares without tiring, and embraces and protects the people without limit.
hexagrams.meaning: Approaching spring, warm influence, growth opportunity
hexagrams.images: Earth lies above the lake. So the wise person teaches and cares without tiring, and embraces and protects the people without limit.
lines: Approaching together in mutual response; steadfastness brings good fortune.
Approaching together in mutual response: good fortune; nothing is unfavourable.
Approaching with sweet words: nothing is gained. Once one grieves over it, there is no fault.
Approaching in full sincerity: no fault.
Approaching with wisdom, as befits a great ruler: good fortune.
Approaching with generous warmth: good fortune, no fault.

hexagrams.name: Kuan
hexagrams.judgment: Contemplation: the hands are washed, but the offering is not yet made. Sincere and dignified, the worshipper draws others to look on with reverence.
hexagrams.image: Wind moves over the earth. So the ancient kings toured the regions, observed the people, and set out teaching.
hexagrams.meaning: Looking down, meditation, viewing the whole field
hexagrams.images: Wind moves over the earth. So the ancient kings toured the regions, observed the people, and set out teaching.
lines: Looking on like a child. For the common person, no fault; for the noble-minded, humiliation.
Looking out through a gap in the door. Fitting for the steadfastness of one who keeps to the inner rooms.
Contemplating the course of one's own life, one decides whether to advance or withdraw.
Contemplating the brilliance of the realm. It is favourable to be received as a guest of the king.
Contemplating the course of one's own life: for the noble-minded, no fault.
Contemplating the lives of others: for the noble-minded, no fault.

hexagrams.name: Shi He
hexagrams.judgment: Biting through: success. It is favourable to settle matters by just judgement.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and lightning come together. So the ancient kings made penalties clear and laws firm.
hexagrams.meaning: Removing obstacles, energetic enforcement of law
hexagrams.images: Thunder and lightning come together. So the ancient kings made penalties clear and laws firm.
lines: Feet held in the stocks, toes hidden from sight. No fault.
Biting through soft meat, the nose disappears into it. No fault.
Biting into dried old meat, one strikes something bitter. A little humiliation, but no fault.
Biting through dried meat on the bone, one finds a metal arrowhead. It is favourable to be steadfast in hardship: good fortune.
Biting through dried lean meat, one finds yellow gold. Steadfast in the face of danger: no fault.
Neck held in a wooden collar, the ears hidden from sight: misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Bi
hexagrams.judgment: Adornment: success. Small undertakings are favourable.
hexagrams.image: A blaze beneath the mountain. The wise person brings light to ordinary matters but does not presume to settle serious disputes by appearance.
hexagrams.meaning: Aesthetic beauty, decoration, temporary outer form
hexagrams.images: A blaze beneath the mountain. The wise person brings light to ordinary matters but does not presume to settle serious disputes by appearance.
lines: Adorning one's feet, one leaves the carriage and goes on foot.
Adorning the beard.
Adorned and glistening as if moistened. Lasting steadfastness brings good fortune.
Ornate or plain? A white steed flies toward you. It is no bandit; it comes to ask for a bride.
Beauty among the hillside gardens. The bolt of silk offered is meagre; there is shame, yet it ends well.
Plain white adornment: no fault.

hexagrams.name: Bo
hexagrams.judgment: Stripping away: it is not favourable to go anywhere.
hexagrams.image: The mountain rests upon the earth. So those above are generous to those below, and so secure their own dwelling.
hexagrams.meaning: Disintegration, collapse of rotten structures
hexagrams.images: The mountain rests upon the earth. So those above are generous to those below, and so secure their own dwelling.
lines: The bed is split at its legs. Steadfastness is worn away: misfortune.
The bed is split at its frame. Steadfastness is worn away: misfortune.
Splitting from those who do harm: no fault.
The bed is split right up to the skin: misfortune.
Like a string of fish, the palace ladies are led in to receive favour. Nothing is unfavourable.
A great fruit remains uneaten. The noble-minded receive a carriage; the petty strip away their own house.

hexagrams.name: Fu
hexagrams.judgment: Returning: things go through. Leaving and coming back meet no harm, companions arrive, and nothing is amiss. The path circles round; after seven days the turn comes back. Having a destination is favourable.
hexagrams.image: Thunder lies within the earth. So at the solstice the ancient kings closed the passes, merchants and travellers stayed still, and the ruler did not tour the regions.
hexagrams.meaning: The turning point, return of light, recovery of energy
hexagrams.images: Thunder lies within the earth. So at the solstice the ancient kings closed the passes, merchants and travellers stayed still, and the ruler did not tour the regions.
lines: Returning before going far: no great regret, and supreme good fortune.
A quiet, gentle return: good fortune.
Returning again and again: danger, but no fault.
Walking in the middle of the crowd, one returns alone.
A return made with sincere generosity: no regret.
Missing the way back: misfortune and calamity. Leading an army this way ends in great defeat and harms the ruler; for ten years no advance is possible.

hexagrams.name: Wu Wang
hexagrams.judgment: Without falseness: great success, and it is favourable to be steadfast. Whoever is not upright meets trouble, and it is not favourable to go anywhere.
hexagrams.image: Thunder rolls beneath heaven, and all things share its innocence. So the ancient kings, in step with the seasons, nourished all living things.
hexagrams.meaning: Natural behavior, acting without ulterior motives
hexagrams.images: Thunder rolls beneath heaven, and all things share its innocence. So the ancient kings, in step with the seasons, nourished all living things.
lines: Acting without falseness, going forward brings good fortune.
Not ploughing yet reaping, not clearing yet using the field: then it is favourable to go somewhere.
Undeserved misfortune: an ox is tethered nearby, the traveller takes it, and the villager bears the loss.
One can stay steadfast: no fault.
An illness that comes undeserved: do not take medicine, and there will be joy.
Even without falseness, acting now brings trouble; nothing is gained.

hexagrams.name: Da Chu
hexagrams.english: The Taming Power of the Great
hexagrams.judgment: Great restraint and gathering: steadfastness is favourable. Taking one's meals away from home brings good fortune. Fording the great river is favourable.
hexagrams.image: Heaven lies within the mountain. So the wise person learns many sayings and deeds of the past, and so stores up their own virtue.
hexagrams.name_english: The Taming Power of the Great
hexagrams.meaning: Focus, storing wisdom, preparation for large work
hexagrams.images: Heaven lies within the mountain. So the wise person learns many sayings and deeds of the past, and so stores up their own virtue.
lines: Danger is near; it is favourable to stop.
The axle-block is removed from the cart.
Fine horses giving chase. It is favourable to be steadfast in hardship. Practise driving and defence daily, and it is favourable to go forward.
A guard-board tied over the young bull's horns: greatly auspicious.
A boar that has been gelded, so its tusks do no harm: auspicious.
Reaching the open road of heaven: success.

hexagrams.name: Yi
hexagrams.judgment: Nourishment: steadfastness brings good fortune. Watch how others are fed, and what one seeks to fill one's own mouth.
hexagrams.image: Beneath the mountain, thunder stirs. The wise person guards their speech and keeps food and drink within measure.
hexagrams.meaning: Providing food, monitoring what enters mouth and mind
hexagrams.images: Beneath the mountain, thunder stirs. The wise person guards their speech and keeps food and drink within measure.
lines: You set aside your magic tortoise and watch me with drooping jaw: misfortune.
Seeking food from below goes against the norm; seeking it from the hill above, setting out brings misfortune.
Turning away from true nourishment: steadfastness here brings misfortune. Do not act on it for ten years; nothing is gained.
Seeking nourishment from below brings good fortune. Staring like a tiger with fixed eyes, ever hungry: no fault.
Departing from the norm. Staying steadfast brings good fortune, but do not cross the great river.
The source of nourishment for others: danger, then good fortune. It is favourable to cross the great river.

hexagrams.name: Da Guo
hexagrams.judgment: Great excess: the main beam bends under the load. Having a destination is favourable; things go through.
hexagrams.image: The lake rises over the trees. So the wise person stands alone without fear, and withdraws from the world without gloom.
hexagrams.meaning: Heavy beam bends, crisis requiring extraordinary action
hexagrams.images: The lake rises over the trees. So the wise person stands alone without fear, and withdraws from the world without gloom.
lines: A mat of white rushes is spread beneath the offering: no fault.
A withered willow puts out new shoots; an old man takes a young wife. Nothing is unfavourable.
The ridgepole sags: misfortune.
The ridgepole is braced and rises: good fortune. Looking elsewhere for support brings humiliation.
An old willow bursts into blossom; an elderly woman marries a youthful husband. Neither fault nor honour.
Wading too deep, the water closes over one's head: misfortune, yet no fault.

hexagrams.name: Kan
hexagrams.judgment: The repeated abyss: hold to sincerity, and the heart finds its way through. Acting in this spirit earns honour.
hexagrams.image: Water flows on and on, arriving again and again. So the wise person keeps virtue constant and keeps practising the work of teaching.
hexagrams.meaning: Double danger, maintaining trust, flowing through deep chasms
hexagrams.images: Water flows on and on, arriving again and again. So the wise person keeps virtue constant and keeps practising the work of teaching.
lines: In the repeated abyss, one falls into a pit within the pit: misfortune.
The abyss is full of danger. Seek only small gains, and they will come.
Coming and going, pit after pit, danger with no place to rest. One has sunk into a hollow; do not act.
A cask of wine and a basket of grain in simple clay pots, passed in at the window. At the last there is nothing wrong.
The abyss does not overflow; the water only rises to the brim and levels out. No fault.
Bound with black cords and held among thorn hedges; for three years one finds no way out: misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Li
hexagrams.judgment: Clinging brightness: it is favourable to be steadfast; success. Caring for the cow brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Brightness rises twice over. So a person of great worth carries the light onward and shines it in all four directions.
hexagrams.meaning: Illumination, clarity, dependency on fuel, consciousness
hexagrams.images: Brightness rises twice over. So a person of great worth carries the light onward and shines it in all four directions.
lines: Footsteps cross in confusion. Treat them with respect, and there is no fault.
Yellow light: supreme good fortune.
Brightness of the sinking sun. Unless one drums on a pot and sings, one will only lament the years of age: misfortune.
It comes suddenly, blazes up, dies down, and is thrown away.
Tears pour down in floods, with sighs of sorrow: good fortune.
The king sends out a campaign and is praised for striking down the leader, while sparing the followers. No fault.

hexagrams.name: Xian
hexagrams.judgment: Mutual influence: success, and it is favourable to be steadfast. Taking a wife brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: A lake rests upon the mountain. So the wise person keeps an open, empty mind and receives others.
hexagrams.meaning: Mutual attraction, courtship, receptive harmony
hexagrams.images: A lake rests upon the mountain. So the wise person keeps an open, empty mind and receives others.
lines: Influence stirs the big toe.
Influence stirs the calves: misfortune. Staying put brings good fortune.
Influence stirs the thighs. Clinging to what one follows and going on brings humiliation.
Steadfastness brings good fortune and regret vanishes. If the mind races to and fro, only one's close friends follow one's thoughts.
The stirring is felt along the nape of the neck: nothing to regret.
Influence reaches the jaws, cheeks and tongue.

hexagrams.name: Heng
hexagrams.judgment: Constancy: success and no fault. It is favourable to be steadfast and to have somewhere to go.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and wind keep company. The wise person takes a stand and holds to their course.
hexagrams.meaning: Persistence, stable marriage of earth/wind forces
hexagrams.images: Thunder and wind keep company. The wise person takes a stand and holds to their course.
lines: Seeking constancy too deeply and too soon: steadfastness here brings misfortune; nothing is gained.
Regret vanishes.
One whose virtue is not constant may meet disgrace. Steadfastness here brings humiliation.
No game in the hunting field.
Keeping one's virtue constant and steadfast: good fortune for the one who follows, misfortune for the one who must lead.
Restless constancy, always shaken: misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Tun
hexagrams.judgment: Retreat brings success. In small matters it is favourable to stay steadfast.
hexagrams.image: Mountain beneath heaven: the peak rises, yet the sky stays out of reach. So the wise person keeps petty people at a distance, without hostility but with firm reserve.
hexagrams.meaning: Strategic withdrawal, saving energy in times of decline
hexagrams.images: Mountain beneath heaven: the peak rises, yet the sky stays out of reach. So the wise person keeps petty people at a distance, without hostility but with firm reserve.
lines: Retreating at the tail end of the line is dangerous. Do not set out to go anywhere now.
Tied with the hide of a yellow ox, a knot nobody can undo. Stay true to what is right.
A retreat held back by ties brings sickness and danger. Caring for servants and dependants brings good fortune.
A willing, timely retreat: good fortune for the noble-minded, but the petty cannot manage it.
A gracious retreat, made at the right moment. Steadfastness brings good fortune.
A carefree, abundant retreat. Everything is favourable.

hexagrams.name: Da Zhuang
hexagrams.judgment: Great strength. It is favourable to stay steadfast and correct.
hexagrams.image: Thunder high in the sky shows great power. So the wise person does not take a single step that goes against propriety.
hexagrams.meaning: Steer holds horns, avoiding head-on clashes, inner discipline
hexagrams.images: Thunder high in the sky shows great power. So the wise person does not take a single step that goes against propriety.
lines: Strength in the toes only. Pushing forward brings misfortune, however sincere one is.
Steadfastness brings good fortune.
The petty use force; the noble-minded do not. Even steadfast, there is danger: a ram butting a hedge gets its horns caught.
Steadfastness brings good fortune and regret vanishes. The hedge gives way and the horns are free; strength lies in the axle of a great cart.
The ram is lost with ease, in the open field. No regret.
The ram butts the hedge and can go neither back nor forward. Nothing is favourable, but accepting the hardship brings good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Jin
hexagrams.judgment: Progress. The prince who brings peace is honoured with many horses and received three times in a single day.
hexagrams.image: The bright sun rises over the earth. So the wise person makes their own bright virtue shine.
hexagrams.meaning: Sun rising over earth, dynamic advancement and honor
hexagrams.images: The bright sun rises over the earth. So the wise person makes their own bright virtue shine.
lines: Advancing, then pushed back: steadfastness brings good fortune. If trust is not yet given, stay generous and easy; no fault.
Advancing, yet full of sorrow: steadfastness brings good fortune. Great blessing comes from the grandmother.
Everyone is in agreement. Regret vanishes.
Advancing like a hoarding squirrel. Even with steadfastness there is danger.
Regret vanishes. Do not fret over gain or loss; going forward brings good fortune and all is favourable.
Advancing with the horns, fit only for disciplining one's own town. Danger, yet good fortune and no fault; still, persisting brings humiliation.

hexagrams.name: Ming Yi
hexagrams.judgment: The light is wounded. It is favourable to remain steadfast in hardship.
hexagrams.image: The light has sunk into the earth. So the wise person, when leading the many, veils their brightness and yet still sees clearly.
hexagrams.meaning: Hiding light under a basket, survival during tyranny
hexagrams.images: The light has sunk into the earth. So the wise person, when leading the many, veils their brightness and yet still sees clearly.
lines: The light wounded in flight; the bird lowers its wings. The noble-minded travel on and go three days without eating. Wherever they go, the host has harsh words.
Wounded in the left thigh, yet rescued by a strong horse. Good fortune.
Wounded while hunting in the south, the great leader of the darkness is captured. Do not rush to set things right.
Going in at the left of the belly, one learns the heart of the darkness, then slips out by the gate and the yard.
The darkening of the light as Prince Ji endured it, hiding his clarity to survive. It is favourable to stay steadfast.
No light, only darkness. First it climbed up to heaven, then it fell into the earth.

hexagrams.name: Jia Ren
hexagrams.judgment: The household. It is favourable for the woman of the house to be steadfast.
hexagrams.image: Wind comes forth from fire. So the wise person's words have substance and their conduct has constancy.
hexagrams.meaning: Internal order, domestic discipline and alignment
hexagrams.images: Wind comes forth from fire. So the wise person's words have substance and their conduct has constancy.
lines: Setting firm boundaries within the household from the start. Regret vanishes.
Not following her own whims, she tends the meals at the centre of the home. Steadfastness brings good fortune.
When tempers flare in the household, there is regret and danger, but good fortune. When wife and children giggle carelessly, it ends in humiliation.
She brings wealth to the household. Great good fortune.
The king approaches his family. Have no worry; good fortune.
Sincere and dignified. In the end, good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Kui
hexagrams.judgment: Estrangement. Small undertakings turn out well.
hexagrams.image: Fire above, the lake below: each moves its own way. So the wise person, while sharing common ground with others, keeps their own distinct character.
hexagrams.meaning: Different paths, finding alignment on minor matters
hexagrams.images: Fire above, the lake below: each moves its own way. So the wise person, while sharing common ground with others, keeps their own distinct character.
lines: Regret vanishes. If the horse is lost, do not chase it; it will come back by itself. Meeting a hostile person: no fault.
Meeting one's lord in a narrow lane. No fault.
The cart is hauled backwards, the oxen are stopped, the driver is marked and cut. A poor start but a sound finish.
Isolated by opposition, one meets a kindred spirit and they trust each other. Danger, but no fault.
Regret vanishes. A kinsman bites through the tender flesh. Going forward, what fault could there be?

Isolated by opposition, one sees a pig covered in mud and a cart full of ghosts. First the bow is drawn, then put down: these are not raiders but suitors. Going on and meeting the rain brings good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Jian
hexagrams.judgment: Obstruction. The southwest is favourable, the northeast is not. It is favourable to see a person of great worth; steadfastness brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Water upon the mountain makes the way hard. So the wise person turns inward and cultivates their own character.
hexagrams.meaning: Mountain before water, need to stop and regroup
hexagrams.images: Water upon the mountain makes the way hard. So the wise person turns inward and cultivates their own character.
lines: Going forward leads to obstruction; coming back earns praise.
The king's servant meets obstruction upon obstruction, and not for their own sake.
Going forward leads to obstruction, so they turn back.
Going forward leads to obstruction; coming back brings allies together.
Amid the worst of the hardship, companions come.
Going forward leads to obstruction; coming back brings great things. Good fortune. It is favourable to see a person of great worth.

hexagrams.name: Xie
hexagrams.judgment: Loosening. The southwest is favourable. With nowhere left to go, coming back is auspicious; with somewhere to go, an early start is auspicious.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and rain break forth, releasing the tension. So the wise person pardons mistakes and deals gently with wrongdoing.
hexagrams.meaning: Release of tension, forgiveness, moving forward quickly
hexagrams.images: Thunder and rain break forth, releasing the tension. So the wise person pardons mistakes and deals gently with wrongdoing.
lines: No fault.
In the hunt, three foxes are caught and a yellow arrow is gained. Steadfastness brings good fortune.
Carrying a load on one's back while riding in a carriage invites robbers. Even with steadfastness there will be humiliation.
Free your big toe. Then friends will come, and with them trust.
The noble-minded find their release: good fortune. This proves itself even to the petty.
The duke looses an arrow at a falcon perched high on the city wall and takes it. Nothing is unfavourable.

hexagrams.name: Sun
hexagrams.judgment: Decrease, with sincerity, brings great good fortune and no fault. One may be steadfast, and it is favourable to set out. How should it be offered? Two simple bowls are enough for the sacrifice.
hexagrams.image: A marsh lies below the mountain. The wise person keeps anger in check and holds desire within bounds.
hexagrams.meaning: Reducing excess, concentrating on simplicity
hexagrams.images: A marsh lies below the mountain. The wise person keeps anger in check and holds desire within bounds.
lines: When one's own work is done, go quickly to help. No fault, but weigh how much to take from yourself.
Steadfastness is favourable; marching out is unlucky. One can add to others without taking anything from oneself.
When three people travel together, one is lost. When one person travels alone, they find a companion.
Decreasing one's faults lets joy come quickly. No fault.
Someone adds to them a tortoise shell worth ten strings of cowries, and it cannot be refused. Great good fortune.
Without decreasing, increase. No fault; steadfastness brings good fortune and it is favourable to set out. One gains helpers who are bound to no household.

hexagrams.name: Yi
hexagrams.judgment: Increase. It is favourable to set out, and favourable to cross the great river.
hexagrams.image: Wind and thunder strengthen each other. So the wise person, seeing good, moves towards it, and seeing their own faults, corrects them.
hexagrams.meaning: Expanding, helping the lower classes, time for undertaking
hexagrams.images: Wind and thunder strengthen each other. So the wise person, seeing good, moves towards it, and seeing their own faults, corrects them.
lines: It is favourable to undertake great works. Great good fortune, no fault.
Someone adds to them a tortoise shell worth ten strings of cowries, and it cannot be refused. Lasting steadfastness brings good fortune. The king makes an offering to the High Lord: good fortune.
Increase comes even through misfortune. No fault. Walking the middle way with sincerity, one reports to the prince bearing a jade token.
Walking the middle way, one reports to the prince and is heeded. It is favourable to be trusted with relocating a city.
With true sincerity and a kind heart, there is no need to ask: great good fortune. Others will trust and honour one's kindness.
No one adds to them; someone even strikes them. Their heart is not constant. Misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Guai
hexagrams.judgment: Resolution. The matter must be made known at the king's court and proclaimed with sincerity, though there is danger. Tell one's own town; taking up arms is not favourable. It is favourable to set out.
hexagrams.image: Marsh water lifted up into the sky. The wise person hands out bounty to those beneath and does not sit upon their own merit.
hexagrams.meaning: Decisive resolution, clearing out remaining obstacles
hexagrams.images: Marsh water lifted up into the sky. The wise person hands out bounty to those beneath and does not sit upon their own merit.
lines: Strength in the forward toes. Going out without being able to prevail is a mistake.
Alert and calling out, even if there are arms in the night, have no fear.
Force shown in the jaw is unlucky. The noble-minded are determined and go on alone; rain soaks them and others are vexed, yet no fault.
No skin on the thighs, and walking falters. If they let themselves be led like a sheep, regret would vanish, but they hear the advice and do not believe it.
Like weeds uprooted, firmly resolved. Walking the middle way: no fault.
No cry of warning. In the end, misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Gou
hexagrams.judgment: Coming to meet. The woman is powerful; do not take such a woman in marriage.
hexagrams.image: Wind blows beneath heaven, reaching everywhere. So the ruler issues commands and proclaims them to the four quarters.
hexagrams.meaning: Sudden temptation, dynamic female influence, caution
hexagrams.images: Wind blows beneath heaven, reaching everywhere. So the ruler issues commands and proclaims them to the four quarters.
lines: Tie it to a bronze brake: steadfastness brings good fortune. Going anywhere brings misfortune; even a lean pig is restless and stamps about.
A fish lies in the bundle. No fault, but it is not one to set before guests.
No skin on the thighs, and walking falters. Danger, but no great fault.
No fish in the wrapper. Starting something now brings misfortune.
A melon wrapped in willow leaves. Hidden brilliance: it falls as if from heaven.
Meeting with the horns. Humiliation, but no fault.

hexagrams.name: Cui
hexagrams.judgment: Gathering brings success. The king approaches his ancestral temple. It is favourable to see a person of great worth; there is success and it is favourable to be steadfast. Offering a great sacrifice brings good fortune, and it is favourable to set out.
hexagrams.image: The lake rises above the earth, waters gathering. So the wise person keeps their tools of defence in order, prepared for the unexpected.
hexagrams.meaning: Mass convergence, alignment of leadership and sacrifices
hexagrams.images: The lake rises above the earth, waters gathering. So the wise person keeps their tools of defence in order, prepared for the unexpected.
lines: Trust that does not last to the end brings disorder, then gathering. A single cry, and one clasp of hands turns it into laughter. Do not fret; going on is no fault.
Being drawn in brings good fortune and no fault. With sincerity, even a small spring offering is enough.
Gathering, but with sighs. Nothing is favourable. Going on is no fault, though there is slight humiliation.
Great good fortune. No fault.
Gathering around one who holds the proper place: no fault. If trust is lacking, sustained, lasting steadfastness makes regret vanish.
Sighing and weeping, with tears and sniffles. No fault.

hexagrams.name: Sheng
hexagrams.judgment: Rising upward brings great success. It is favourable to see a person of great worth; have no worry. Setting out to the south brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Wood grows up from within the earth. So the wise person follows virtue patiently, piling up small things until they become high and great.
hexagrams.meaning: Gradual vertical progress, steady effort and growth
hexagrams.images: Wood grows up from within the earth. So the wise person follows virtue patiently, piling up small things until they become high and great.
lines: Rising with others' welcome brings great good fortune.
With sincerity, even a small spring offering is enough. No fault.
Rising into an empty city.
The king makes an offering on Mount Qi. Good fortune, no fault.
Steadfastness brings good fortune. One climbs the steps.
Rising in the dark. It is favourable to be steadfast without pause.

hexagrams.name: Kun
hexagrams.judgment: Exhaustion, yet success. For the steadfast person of great worth there is good fortune and no fault. Words spoken now will not be believed.
hexagrams.image: The lake has no water in it. So the wise person will stake their life to fulfil their purpose.
hexagrams.meaning: Exhaustion, dry well, testing of resolve and speechlessness
hexagrams.images: The lake has no water in it. So the wise person will stake their life to fulfil their purpose.
lines: Sitting exhausted beneath a bare tree, they wander into a dark valley and are not seen for three years.
Weary amid food and wine, when the official in the red sash comes. It is favourable to make offerings. Setting out brings misfortune, but there is no fault.
Hemmed in by rock, leaning on thorns. Entering their house, they do not see their wife. Misfortune.
Coming on slowly, hemmed in within a gilded carriage. Shame, but there is a conclusion.
Nose and feet cut off, oppressed by the one in the scarlet sash. Joy comes slowly. It is favourable to make offerings and sacrifices.
Tangled in creeping vines, teetering and unsteady. They say, 'If I move, I will regret it.' Yet after regret, setting out brings good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Jing
hexagrams.judgment: The well. Towns may move, yet the well stays where it is. It is never drained and never overflows, and all who pass draw from it. If the rope nearly reaches the water and the pitcher cracks, misfortune.
hexagrams.image: Water rises above the wood. So the wise person encourages the people at their work and urges them to help one another.
hexagrams.meaning: Inexhaustible source of life-force, maintaining the structure
hexagrams.images: Water rises above the wood. So the wise person encourages the people at their work and urges them to help one another.
lines: The well is muddy and no one drinks. Not even birds come to the old well.
The well's hole shoots water only at the small fish. The jug is cracked and leaks.
The well has been cleaned, yet no one drinks; it grieves my heart. It could be drawn from. If the king were clear-sighted, all would share the blessing.
The well is being lined with brick. No fault.
The well is clear, its spring cold and fresh. People drink.
Water is drawn from the well and it is left uncovered. With sincerity, great good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Ge
hexagrams.judgment: When the appointed day arrives, people trust the change. Great success; it is favourable to be steadfast, and regret vanishes.
hexagrams.image: Fire burns within the lake. The wise person keeps the calendar in order and makes the turning of the seasons clear.
hexagrams.meaning: Discarding old skins, seasonal change, timing is critical
hexagrams.images: Fire burns within the lake. The wise person keeps the calendar in order and makes the turning of the seasons clear.
lines: Held fast in yellow oxhide. Keep still; the moment for change has not yet arrived.
When the day has come, make the change. Going forward brings good fortune; no fault.
Pressing ahead brings misfortune, and stubbornness is dangerous. Once talk of change has come round three times, it can be trusted.
Regret vanishes. With trust, the mandate itself is renewed. Good fortune.
A person of great worth changes like a tiger's stripes. Trust is there even before the oracle is consulted.
The noble-minded change like the leopard's coat; the petty change only their faces. Pushing on brings misfortune; staying steadfast brings good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Ding
hexagrams.judgment: The cauldron. Great good fortune and success.
hexagrams.image: Fire burns above wood. The wise person stands in the right place and gives firm shape to what heaven has assigned.
hexagrams.meaning: Vessel of transformation, spiritual nourishment, alchemy
hexagrams.images: Fire burns above wood. The wise person stands in the right place and gives firm shape to what heaven has assigned.
lines: The cauldron turned over onto its feet, good for clearing out stale remains. A secondary wife is taken because of her son; nothing wrong.
The cauldron is full. Rivals are jealous but cannot reach me. Good fortune.
The cauldron's handles are altered, so it cannot be moved; the rich pheasant fat goes uneaten. When the rain falls, regret eases, and the end is good.
The cauldron's leg breaks and the lord's meal spills, soiling everything. Misfortune.
The cauldron has yellow handles and golden carrying rings. It is favourable to be steadfast.
The cauldron has carrying rings of jade. Great good fortune; nothing is unfavourable.

hexagrams.name: Zhen
hexagrams.judgment: Thunder brings success. It comes and people tremble, then they laugh and talk again. It startles for a hundred miles, yet the one at the rite does not drop the ladle or the sacred wine.
hexagrams.image: Thunder follows thunder. In awe of it, the wise person puts their life in order and examines themselves.
hexagrams.meaning: Startling thunder, awakening, initial fear turning to laughter
hexagrams.images: Thunder follows thunder. In awe of it, the wise person puts their life in order and examines themselves.
lines: Thunder comes and there is fear, but afterwards laughter and easy talk. Good fortune.
Thunder comes with danger; great wealth is lost. Climb the nine hills and do not chase it; in seven days it returns.
The shock leaves one dazed. If the shock moves one to act, there is no harm.
The thunder sinks into the mud and its force is spent.
Thunder goes and comes, and there is danger. Yet nothing is lost; there is work to attend to.
Shaking all over, staring wildly; going forth brings misfortune. If the thunder strikes the neighbour rather than oneself, no fault. Kin by marriage may complain.

hexagrams.name: Gen
hexagrams.judgment: Keeping the back still, one no longer feels the self. Walking in the courtyard, one does not see the people there. No fault.
hexagrams.image: Mountain stands upon mountain. The wise person keeps their thoughts within their own place.
hexagrams.meaning: Meditation, stopping action at the right time, spine alignment
hexagrams.images: Mountain stands upon mountain. The wise person keeps their thoughts within their own place.
lines: Keeping the toes still. No fault; it is favourable to stay steadfast for a long time.
Keeping the calves still. One cannot save the one being followed, and the heart is unhappy.
Keeping the hips still while the back is wrenched. Danger; the heart smoulders.
Keeping the trunk still. No fault.
Keeping the jaws still, so that words come in good order. Regret vanishes.
Stillness that is generous and sincere. Good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Jian
hexagrams.judgment: Gradual progress, like a maiden going to her marriage in due order: good fortune. It is favourable to be steadfast.
hexagrams.image: A tree grows upon the mountain. The wise person dwells in worthy virtue and slowly improves the ways of the people.
hexagrams.meaning: Slow progress, wild geese flying in formation
hexagrams.images: A tree grows upon the mountain. The wise person dwells in worthy virtue and slowly improves the ways of the people.
lines: The wild goose slowly nears the shore. The young one is in danger and there is talk, but no fault.
The wild goose slowly reaches the great rock and eats and drinks in peace. Good fortune.
The wild goose comes to the high dry ground. A husband sets out and never comes back; a wife is with child but the child is not raised. Misfortune. Guarding against raiders is favourable.
The wild goose reaches the tree and may find a flat branch to rest on. No fault.
The wild goose reaches the summit. For three years the wife has no child, but in the end nothing prevails against her. Good fortune.
The wild goose flies on to the heights; its feathers can be used in the sacred dance. Good fortune.

hexagrams.name: Gui Mei
hexagrams.judgment: The marrying maiden. Pushing forward brings misfortune; nothing is favourable.
hexagrams.image: Thunder rolls above the lake. The wise person, thinking of what lasts to the end, understands what wears away.
hexagrams.meaning: Impulsive action before correctness, lack of authority
hexagrams.images: Thunder rolls above the lake. The wise person, thinking of what lasts to the end, understands what wears away.
lines: The maiden marries as a junior wife. The lame can still walk; going forward brings good fortune.
The one-eyed can still see. The steadfastness of a quiet, solitary person is favourable.
The maiden is sent off as a servant; she returns, and marries as a junior wife.
The maiden lets the time of marriage pass. A late marriage still comes in its season.
King Di Yi marries off his sister. The bride's robes are less fine than her bridesmaid's. The moon is close to full. Auspicious.
The woman holds a basket with nothing in it; the man cuts the sheep and no blood flows. Nothing is favourable.

hexagrams.name: Feng
hexagrams.judgment: Fullness goes through; the king reaches it. Have no cares; be as the noonday sun.
hexagrams.image: Thunder and lightning arrive together. The wise person decides disputes and carries out just penalties.
hexagrams.meaning: Peak illumination, transient glory, preparing for decline
hexagrams.images: Thunder and lightning arrive together. The wise person decides disputes and carries out just penalties.
lines: Meeting a lord who is one's match; even ten days together bring no fault. Going forward wins esteem.
The screen is so thick that the Dipper shows at noon. Going brings suspicion and dislike, but if sincerity is roused, good fortune.
The curtain is so dense that small stars show at noon. One breaks the right arm. No fault.
The screen is so thick that the Dipper shows at noon. One meets a lord of like mind. Good fortune.
Brilliance draws near, bringing blessing and renown. Good fortune.
A grand house with the family screened inside. Peering through the gate, all is silent; for three years no one is seen. Misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Lu
hexagrams.judgment: The traveller finds small success. For one on the road, steadfastness brings good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Fire burns upon the mountain. The wise person is clear and careful in giving penalties and does not let cases drag on.
hexagrams.meaning: Moving through foreign lands, cautious behavior, temporary shelter
hexagrams.images: Fire burns upon the mountain. The wise person is clear and careful in giving penalties and does not let cases drag on.
lines: The traveller fusses over petty things and so draws misfortune upon themselves.
On the road, one finds lodging, keeps one's goods close by, and gains a faithful young attendant.
The traveller's inn burns down and the young servant is lost. Steadfastness is dangerous.
The traveller finds a place to stay and gains money and an axe, yet the heart is not at ease.
Shooting a pheasant, one arrow is lost. In the end this brings praise and an office.
The bird burns its own nest. The traveller laughs at first and wails later, having carelessly lost the ox. Misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Xun
hexagrams.judgment: The gentle wind brings small success. It is favourable to have somewhere to go and to see a person of great worth.
hexagrams.image: Wind follows upon wind. The wise person repeats their instructions and carries out their affairs.
hexagrams.meaning: Penetrating influence, flexibility, persistent action
hexagrams.images: Wind follows upon wind. The wise person repeats their instructions and carries out their affairs.
lines: Advancing and retreating without decision. The steadfastness of a warrior is favourable.
Penetrating even beneath the bed, calling many scribes and diviners. Good fortune; no fault.
Bowing again and again under pressure. Humiliation.
Regret vanishes. Out hunting, game of three kinds is caught.
Steadfastness brings good fortune and regret vanishes; nothing is unfavourable. No good start, but a good end. Three days before the change and three days after: good fortune.
Beneath the bed, the money and the axe are lost. Steadfastness brings misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Dui
hexagrams.judgment: Joy brings success. It is favourable to be steadfast.
hexagrams.image: Lake rests beside lake. The wise person meets with friends to discuss and practise together.
hexagrams.meaning: Joy, shared discourse, friendly persuasion, openness
hexagrams.images: Lake rests beside lake. The wise person meets with friends to discuss and practise together.
lines: Joy in harmony. Good fortune.
Joy rooted in sincerity. Good fortune; regret vanishes.
Joy that comes chasing pleasure. Misfortune.
Weighing one pleasure against another, one finds no rest. Keeping clear of what harms brings gladness.
Trusting what wears one down. There is danger.
Joy that draws one along and leads one astray.

hexagrams.name: Huan
hexagrams.judgment: Dispersion brings success. The king goes to his ancestral temple. It is favourable to cross the great river and to be steadfast.
hexagrams.image: Wind moves across the water. The ancient kings made offerings to the Lord on High and built temples.
hexagrams.meaning: Dissolving blockages, crossing the great water
hexagrams.images: Wind moves across the water. The ancient kings made offerings to the Lord on High and built temples.
lines: Bringing help with a strong horse. Good fortune.
As things scatter, one hurries to what gives support. Regret vanishes.
Letting go of concern for oneself. No regret.
Dissolving one's own faction brings great good fortune. From scattering, a hill of people gathers, beyond what ordinary minds would imagine.
Amid dispersion, a great proclamation goes out like sweat from the body, and the king's stores are given out. No fault.
Scattering the bloodshed, going far away from danger. No fault.

hexagrams.name: Jie
hexagrams.judgment: Limitation brings success. But harsh, bitter limits cannot be kept up steadily.
hexagrams.image: Water lies above the lake. The wise person sets proper numbers and measures and weighs what is virtuous conduct.
hexagrams.meaning: Frugality, boundary definition, keeping moderation
hexagrams.images: Water lies above the lake. The wise person sets proper numbers and measures and weighs what is virtuous conduct.
lines: Not going out beyond the inner courtyard door. No fault.
Not going out beyond the outer gate. Misfortune.
Without limits there will be lament. No fault but one's own.
Limitation accepted with ease. Success.
Limitation that is sweet. Good fortune; going forward wins esteem.
Limitation that is bitter. Steadfastness brings misfortune, yet regret vanishes.

hexagrams.name: Zhong Fu
hexagrams.judgment: Sincerity at the centre, reaching even to pigs and fish: auspicious. Fording the great river is favourable, and so is steadfastness.
hexagrams.image: Wind moves above the lake. The wise person deliberates carefully over cases and delays sentences of death.
hexagrams.meaning: Pigs and fishes aligned, supreme sincerity, faith
hexagrams.images: Wind moves above the lake. The wise person deliberates carefully over cases and delays sentences of death.
lines: Being calm and prepared brings good fortune. Hidden designs bring no peace.
In the shadows a crane cries out and its chick replies. I have a good cup of wine, and I would drink it with you.
Finding a counterpart: now drumming, now stopping, now weeping, now singing.
The moon is nearly full, and one horse of the pair goes its own way. No fault.
Sincerity that binds people together. No fault.
The cockcrow rises up to heaven, a sound without substance. Steadfastness brings misfortune.

hexagrams.name: Hsiao Kuo
hexagrams.judgment: Small excess brings success; it is favourable to be steadfast. Small things may be done, not great ones. The flying bird leaves its cry behind: better not to rise but to come down. Great good fortune.
hexagrams.image: Thunder sounds above the mountain. The wise person leans a little toward reverence in conduct, grief in mourning, and thrift in spending.
hexagrams.meaning: Keeping low, avoiding flight, attention to detail
hexagrams.images: Thunder sounds above the mountain. The wise person leans a little toward reverence in conduct, grief in mourning, and thrift in spending.
lines: The bird flies when it should not. Misfortune.
Passing the grandfather, one meets the grandmother; not reaching the ruler, one meets the minister. No fault.
Without taking extra care, one may be followed and struck down. Misfortune.
No fault; one meets it without overstepping. Going on is dangerous and calls for caution; do not hold rigidly to one course.
Dense clouds from the western outskirts, yet no rain. The prince shoots with a cord and takes the one hiding in the cave.
Not meeting it, one overshoots; the flying bird is caught in the net. Misfortune, a calamity of one's own making.

hexagrams.name: Ji Ji
hexagrams.judgment: After completion, small success. It is favourable to be steadfast. At first good fortune, in the end disorder.
hexagrams.image: Water stands above fire. The wise person thinks about troubles ahead and guards against them in advance.
hexagrams.meaning: Boiling water on fire, perfect order fading to chaos
hexagrams.images: Water stands above fire. The wise person thinks about troubles ahead and guards against them in advance.
lines: Braking the wheels, the fox wets its tail. No fault.
The woman loses the screen of her carriage. Do not chase it; in seven days it returns.
The High Ancestor campaigned against the Demon Country and took three years to prevail. Petty people must not be employed.
Fine silk can turn to rags; keep rags ready for a leak and stay watchful all day.
The eastern neighbour slaughters an ox, but the western neighbour's simple offering truly receives the blessing.
The head goes under the water. Danger.

hexagrams.name: Wei Ji
hexagrams.judgment: Before completion there is success. The little fox has nearly crossed the river when it wets its tail. Nothing is favourable.
hexagrams.image: Fire stands above water. The wise person carefully tells things apart and sets each in its proper place.
hexagrams.meaning: Fire above water, potential, the young fox wetting its tail
hexagrams.images: Fire stands above water. The wise person carefully tells things apart and sets each in its proper place.
lines: The fox wets its tail. Humiliation.
Braking the wheels. Steadfastness brings good fortune.
Not yet across: pushing forward brings misfortune, yet it is favourable to cross the great river.
Steadfastness brings good fortune and regret vanishes. Rousing to march against the Demon Country, after three years one is rewarded by the great realm.
Steadfastness brings good fortune; no regret. The light of the noble-minded is sincere. Good fortune.
There is trust while drinking wine together; no fault. But if one soaks one's head, trust is lost.
